newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean values mostly flat.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean values mostly flat.

text.p: Grain and soybean FOB values were largely unchanged Wednesday in quiet pre-holiday trading, exporters said.
"There really wasn't much going on in that market," a Chicago-based exporter said.
The U.S. Thanksgiving holiday on Thursday quelled activity in cash and futures markets, and many look for activity on Friday to be quiet as well.
U.S. wheat exporters said they were not surprised that Sri Lanka bought wheat from Argentina instead of the U.S. in a recent tender because Argentine wheat was less expensive.
"I don't think anyone is disappointed over that trade," one exporter said. "I think the wheat market was just due for a correction."
CBOT December wheat futures closed down 12-1/2 cents per bushel at $4.00-1/2.
